name: Community Suite (All-in-One)
description: All custom apps in one build: Music + Internet Radio + QR Remote, Alarm/Timer/Stopwatch, Gemini Live, MCP Bridge, unified Home/Volume top bar, /sd/config & /sd/avatars.

name: Music Player
description: MicroSD MP3/WAV player, AAC/MP3 Internet Radio, mobile Web Remote with QR code & Wi-Fi upload, unified Home/Volume top bar, and /sd/avatars support.

name: Alarm Clock
description: Native Alarm Clock with RTC sync, Countdown Timer, Stopwatch with laps, synth tones & SD MP3 ringtones, unified Home/Volume top bar, and /sd/avatars.

name: Gemini Live
description: Hands-free real-time voice assistant via Gemini Live API with adaptive VAD, voice & pitch settings, /sd/config/gemini.txt, unified top bar, and /sd/avatars.

name: MCP Bridge
description: Hands-free voice & robot bridge for Antigravity IDE with dual FREE/AGENT avatars, camera preview, MOVE gestures, unified top bar, and /sd/avatars.
